== Enchanting ==
''Notes''
* Enchants apply '''only''' to your currently equipped [[Pans|pan]] and [[Shovels|shovel]]. Max '''1''' enchant per pan/shovel (you can re-enchant anytime).

== Available Enchantments ==
<tabber>

|-| Pans =

== How to Enchant ==
[[File:Fortune Altar.png|thumb|The '''Fortune River Altar''']]
* Head over to the Mysterious Altar located behind the Alchemist Store in {{Fortune River}}.
* <span style="font-weight:bold;color:#ef437c;">Make sure that the pan you want to enchant is the one you have equipped.</span>
* Interact with the altar and choose "Enchant my pan".
* Click an ore ([[Aurorite]], [[Aetherite]], or [[Aetherium]]) on the left side. <span style="font-weight:bold;color:red;">Enchanting will happen immediately!</span> Make sure you don't accidentally click on an ore while scrolling through the list!
* The name and stats of the resulting enchant will be shown on the right. If it's not the enchant you wanted, keep clicking ores; otherwise, close the interface.

''Notes''  
* As an alternative to taking your chances with the altar, [[Relics#Enchant_Relics|Enchant books]] are available from the [[Traveling Merchant]] and [[Excavations|Excavation Sites]] for some enchant types.
* The weight or modifier of the ore does '''not''' affect the rarity of the enchant you might get.

== How to Enchant ==
[[File:Oasis Altar.png|thumb|The '''Oasis Altar''']]

* Head over to the Mysterious Altar located in {{Azuralite Oasis}} in [[Crystal Caverns]].
* <span style="font-weight:bold;color:#ef437c;">Make sure the shovel you want to enchant is the one you have equipped.</span>
* Interact with the altar and choose "Enchant my shovel".
* Click an [[Aetherite]] or [[Aetherium]] on the left side. <span style="font-weight:bold;color:red;">Enchanting will happen immediately!</span> Make sure you don't accidentally click on an ore while scrolling through the list!
* The name and stats of the resulting enchant will be shown on the right. If it's not the enchant you wanted, keep clicking ores; otherwise, close the interface.

''Notes''
* Completing [[Quests#tabber-Azuralite_Oasis|'''The Seed of Light''']] quest is required in order to unlock certain rarer enchants.
